title: Dragging snaps to other objects and to an optional grid
body:
Dragging in acre-gui moves an object by the raw pointer offset, rounded to whole pixels by `scene::edit::move_edits`.

## Proposal

- While dragging, the left edge, centre and right edge of the dragged box snap to those of other objects, and so do the top, middle and bottom. A snap reaches about 6 screen pixels, so it feels the same at any zoom, and moving past that frees the object at once.
- A thin guide line shows each snap that holds, so no snap is hidden.
- A `Grid` toggle in the toolbar draws a faint grid, off by default, and snaps the box's top-left corner to it when no alignment snap holds. A number field beside it sets the spacing in canvas pixels, 10 by default.
- A `Snap` toggle in the toolbar turns snapping off. No modifier key, since the viewer takes no new key bindings.
- The snap logic is plain code with unit tests, apart from egui.
